violation_type.title: Operation Open to Parents At All Times (26 TAC §746.201(7))
violation_type.short_title: Operation Open to Parents At All Times
violation_type.typical_finding: Observed that facility does not allow parents to have access inside the building to drop off children.

finding_variants.text: Observed that facility does not allow parents to have access inside the building to drop off children.
It was determine the operation did not allowing parents in the building.
During the investigation inspection it was discoved that parents are not allowed inside the operation during operating hours.
Based on observation and interviews, the operation did not have an open-door policy. Parents were not allowed in the operation during morning drop-off.
Operation had two signs by the classroom doors stating, "No parents beyong this point."        Note:  Signs were removed during inspection.
During the monitoring inspection it was observed that signs were posted preventing parent access  to come fully into the operation.
